title: Sentinel Agent Frontmatter Schema
description: Reference schema for the YAML frontmatter of every .claude/agents/**/*.md file. PORTED FROM UPSTREAM (claude-code-lab) and adapted: color/kb_domains/<example> blocks are recommended-not-required so the initial Sentinel agent fleet (12 agents at bootstrap) passes. Tighten requirements as the fleet matures. No CI gate yet (per the Phase-0 bootstrap decision); see .claude/docs/ROADMAP.md for when to enforce.

name.description: kebab-case identifier; must match the filename without .md.

description.description: One sentence summary + 'Use PROACTIVELY when …' trigger. Auto-invocation depends on the exact 'Use PROACTIVELY' phrasing. Recommended: include at least one <example> block describing a worked invocation.

oneOf.description: Comma-separated tool list (current Sentinel convention from bootstrap).
Tool list as YAML array (lab convention; preferred long-term).

tools.description: Whitelist of tools the agent may use. mcp__* wildcards allowed.

model.description: Model tier. Picking guide: haiku = simple lookups, classification, format conversion. sonnet = most engineering work (default). opus = deep design, complex multi-step planning, hard debugging.

disallowedTools.description: Optional. Space-separated list of tools the agent must not use (e.g., 'Write Edit' for read-only agents).

color.description: Optional in Sentinel today; required in upstream lab. Color tag for UI hint. Adopt when the fleet grows past ~20 agents and visual grouping helps.

kb_domains.description: Optional in Sentinel today; required in upstream lab. Leaf folder names from .claude/kb/ this agent consults. Empty array [] is valid for cross-cutting agents (workflow, exploration, communication). Documenting kb_domains enables automated KB <-> agent linkage; recommended for new agents.

memory.description: Optional. Set to 'user' for agents that benefit from cross-session memory.

effort.description: Optional. Reasoning intensity hint. low = file ops/summarization, standard = most agents (default), high = complex multi-step reasoning.

docs_refs.description: Optional. Filenames from .claude/docs/ this agent should consult. Sentinel-specific: rust-specialist should declare 'RUST_PROJECT_STANDARDS.md', for example.
